tables.note: Following per outlet × issue cell (periphery 26 cells, semi-periphery 26; timing 37 cells with at least 10 matched events). Fixed effects: tier (periphery = 1, semi-periphery = 0) and issue (two dummies, Ukraine and Gaza against COP); random intercepts for outlet nested in country (restricted maximum likelihood). Salience is the event-adjusted correlation, framing the bias-corrected similarity, timing the negative median lag in days, so a positive b means closer following in the periphery. p values are two-sided Wald tests before Holm correction; the Holm-adjusted decisions across the nine confirmatory tests are in Table T6. A random-effect variance estimated at zero was dropped and the model refitted; both fits are listed. The index check enters Gunaratne's 2022 score (India 2.83, Malaysia 0.66, Nigeria 0.44, South Africa 0.41, Bangladesh 0.34, Kenya 0.09) in place of tier; H1 predicts a negative coefficient.
